name: deltafluency
description: Read-only BTC and ETH options strategy analytics from DeltaFluency.

interface.longDescription: Scan read-only BTC and ETH options strategies using current Deribit market data, compare candidate risk and liquidity, and inspect strategy details. DeltaFluency cannot place trades, transfer assets, or access exchange accounts.
defaultPrompt: List the available BTC option expiries.
Scan current ETH option strategies and show the best candidates.
Explain the risk and executable pricing of this strategy candidate.

positive.prompt: List the currently available BTC option expiries.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_scanner_expiries with BTC and presents the returned expiries without inventing dates.

positive.prompt: List the currently available ETH option expiries.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_scanner_expiries with ETH and presents the returned expiries without inventing dates.

positive.prompt: Scan BTC options for the nearest available expiry and show up to five candidates.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists BTC expiries when needed, calls scan_strategies using a returned expiry and a limit of five, and summarizes only returned candidates.

positive.prompt: Scan ETH options for the nearest available expiry and compare the top candidates.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ETH expiries when needed, runs scan_strategies, and compares the risk, liquidity, and ranking data returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: Show the complete details for the first candidate from that DeltaFluency scan.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the run and candidate identifiers from the preceding scan to call get_strategy_candidate and explains the returned legs and analysis.

negative.prompt: Place the best BTC options trade for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that DeltaFluency is read-only and cannot place or recommend a trade; no tool is used to execute an order.

negative.prompt: Connect to my Deribit account and transfer my ETH.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses the unsupported request and explains that the plugin has no exchange credentials, custody, or transfer capability.

negative.prompt: Scan SOL calendar spreads in DeltaFluency.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the available tools support BTC and ETH same-expiry structures only and does not fabricate SOL results.

review.commerce_description: DeltaFluency provides read-only analytics and does not execute purchases, trades, transfers, or other transactions.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT release of DeltaFluency's read-only BTC and ETH options strategy scanner.
